reason: Prior scores are noisy battery measurements and establish no candidate gain, so they do not support attributing benefit to any proposal. I rank isolated changes to address updates and full-tile loops first because they preserve FP32 operations, accumulation order, and layout, with limited correctness risk. The n=512 path is guarded, but overlaps the unmeasured constant-bound source. Packing and layout changes add timed work; the scalar loop-order proposal also gives up SME MOPA, so they rank lower. All proposals still need correctness checks and serial measurements against fresh AC controls.
